section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a single study investigating the relationship between psychological processes and positive body image in Portuguese women and female adolescents (aged 18-55). Participants (N = 288) were recruited online via email and Facebook using snowball sampling and completed an online questionnaire protocol via LimeSurvey. Table 1 presents descriptive statistics and intercorrelations for self-report measures including BMI, self-compassionate engagement, acceptance and action, and Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), showing a significant negative correlation of -0.30 between BAS-2 and BMI (p < .001).
